observed_source_defects: Employee history collapses distinct period/report/filing/acceptance dates and drops zero counts.
Adjacent records are assumed to represent one year; elapsed calendar periods are not checked.
CAGR years equal row count minus one, irrespective of dates.
Revenue and headcount are paired by array position without issuer, currency, basis or fiscal-period validation.
Top-50/30/25 caps omit the remaining scored company records.
Unqualified expansion and bagger scores can trigger an active notification path; no native invocation is used for this audit.
